| Temperature                                    | Oil requirement                                                                                                                                                                    |
|------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Bearing temperatures exceed 180°F (82°C)       | Use ISO viscosity grade 100 with bearing-frame cooling or finned-tube oil cooler. The finned-tube oil cooler is standard with the HT 3196 model and optional for all other models. |
| Pumped-fluid temperatures exceed 350°F (177°C) | Use synthetic lubrication.                                                                                                                                                         |
